# Original Rcb4Lib dependency

This directory retains Kondo's original Python communication library and notices. Use [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) and the adjacent `manufacturer_licence/` directory for the original terms. The original README/comment encoding has been preserved; this English guide does not replace or grant rights beyond the supplier's notices.

Reviewers do not need to install, import or execute this serial-control library. The offline model checks use saved measurements. Acquisition code uses the library to communicate with the RCB-4 controller; starting that code requires hardware-specific configuration and calibration. The experiment-level English READMEs document these distinctions.
